name: Himeno Miyako
source:
Hanaryou Jouban Academy, 3rd year student. Student Council President and Captain of the Superpower Club.
Her father is the president of the major company Jersy Maker HIMENO.
She has the superpower "Gravitation" that allows her to control gravity.
